name: agentarmy-otel-collector
description: OpenTelemetry Collector function-tier image — sidecar to every spoke + standalone fleet collector. Receives OTLP (gRPC :4317, HTTP :4318) from spokes, batches, redacts PII at the sidecar boundary, and exports to one or more backends (file (default), Tempo via OTLP/gRPC, Honeycomb via OTLP/HTTP). Standalone mode adds tail sampling for cost control. Realizes ARC-ADR-010 (observability standard) and the OTel-init remediation track from ARC-ADR-024 (platform maturity audit).

shims.note: Base image otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib already contains the collector binary + every processor/exporter we use (batch, tail_sampling, otlp, otlphttp, file, debug, health_check). No additional package installs.

baked.purpose: Sidecar mode: OTLP receivers + batch + resource attrs + attribute redaction + OTLP forward to OTEL_DOWNSTREAM_ENDPOINT.
Standalone mode: same receivers + tail-sampler (keep errors + probabilistic) + file/tempo/honeycomb exporter selection via OTEL_EXPORTER env.
Selects config file based on OTELCOL_MODE (sidecar | standalone, default standalone).

doctor.description: /:13133 returns 200; OTLP HTTP POST on :4318/v1/traces returns 200/202; TCP :4317 (gRPC) accepts connections; span emitted by doctor appears in the file exporter output (default) — when host can't see the file, checks inside the container via docker exec.

deploy.notes: Two deployment modes: (a) sidecar — co-deployed with each spoke, no public ingress; (b) standalone fleet collector — public ingress for cross-cloud span aggregation.

contract.note: OTel trace-context contract (XC-2 in backlog). The collector itself is config-driven; the contract is the W3C trace-context propagation + OTLP wire format it consumes.
